title: Harvey announces Harvey Tenet, its first in-house, proprietary model for legal work, trained on mock disputes and case files using a version of Kimi K3 (Melia Robinson/Business Insider)
summary: Melia Robinson / Business Insider: Harvey announces Harvey Tenet, its first in-house, proprietary model for legal work, trained on mock disputes and case files using a version of Kimi K3 — Harvey built an $11 billion legal-software business on top of other companies' AI models. Now it's trying to prove it can build one of its own.
